title: D&D Simulator Pack v1.0.0
description: JSON Schema for content packs consumed by a conformant engine. Mirrors the prose in specs/04-content-packs-and-sfs.md (Section 2 for the top-level shape; Section 6 for the *Def shapes referenced below). Unknown top-level keys MUST be rejected at load time; this is enforced here via `additionalProperties: false`. Shared primitive types (ids, RollSpec, RollResult, Modifier, DamageInstance, PersistentEffectInstance, JsonFilter, etc.) live in specs/sfs/v1/_common.json and are referenced via relative $ref.
